summary: Join our Gender-Sensitive Community Development Training Course to learn how to foster inclusivity and drive positive change in your community.
lede: Gender-sensitive community development helps practitioners identify gender gaps and design inclusive programs. For community development practitioners, project managers, social workers, and others implementing community programs, this means using gender analysis tools, engaging diverse groups in safe and meaningful participation, and shaping responsive interventions. The course also covers tracking inclusivity through gender-sensitive indicators and sex-disaggregated data.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for individuals who are at the forefront of community development and are keen to incorporate gender-sensitive practices into their work.
audience: Gender equality advocates and inclusion specialists
modules: Community Engagement Through a Gender Lens
Gender in Specific Sectors (Health, Education, Livelihoods, Governance)
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) for Gender Outcomes
Addressing Gender Biases and Power Dynamics in Development Work
Gender and Social Protection in Community Development
Communicating and Advocating for Gender-Responsive Development
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of community development principles. Prior experience in development projects is beneficial but not mandatory.
